data.body_html:
Planning a Marbella family boat day with jetski, snorkel and paddleboard? You’re in the right place. Departing from Puerto Banús, our charters combine the thrill of a jetski with the calm of snorkelling and paddleboarding — all with a licensed skipper, fuel, drinks and snacks included. Prices start at €749 for 2 hours on an Astondoa 40 or Azimut 39, and go up to €2,299 for a full 8-hour day. For larger groups, the Mangusta 80 at €4,719 for 4 hours includes a jetski free of charge.

Why choose a family boat day in Marbella?

Marbella’s coastline is made for family adventures. From the glamour of Puerto Banús to the quiet coves of Cala del Faro and Cala Cortés, you’ll find calm, clear water perfect for snorkelling and paddleboarding. A private charter means you set the pace — no crowded tour boats, no fixed schedules. Your skipper knows the best spots for the day’s conditions, so you can relax and enjoy the water.

Every booking includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance and safety equipment. Spanish IVA (21%) is always included in the price — no hidden extras.

What’s included in your family charter

  • Licensed skipper and fuel
  • Water, soft drinks, beer, white wine and cava
  • Light snacks (nachos, olives, fruit)
  • Snorkelling masks and fins (on request)
  • Paddleboard (on request, subject to availability)
  • Jetski (included free on Mangusta 80; add-on for other boats)
  • Insurance and safety equipment, including kids’ life jackets
  • Spanish IVA (21%)

Fleet options for your family day

We have boats for every family size. For a smaller group, the Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) or Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax) are perfect — both depart from Puerto Banús and come in at €749 for 2 hours or €2,299 for 8 hours. If you have up to 12 guests and want more space, the Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) starts at €4,719 for 4 hours and includes a jetski free. For other boats like the Azimut 58 Flybridge, Ferretti 94 or Maiora 26m, pricing is on request via WhatsApp.

Jetski, snorkel and paddleboard: how it works

On the Mangusta 80, a jetski is included free for 4-hour charters — perfect for teens and adults. For other boats, you can add a jetski for an extra fee (ask via WhatsApp). Snorkel masks and fins are available on request, and we can provide a paddleboard for calm-water sessions. Your skipper will choose safe, sheltered spots like Cala del Faro or the waters off Cabopino, so everyone can enjoy the water without worry.

A typical family itinerary from Puerto Banús

Start at Puerto Banús, cruise past the Golden Mile and the Marbella coastline. Anchor at a calm cove for snorkelling and paddleboarding. After lunch (snacks included), enjoy a jetski session or simply swim. Head back to port with time to spare. For an 8-hour day, you can extend to Estepona or Sotogrande, depending on sea conditions.

What to bring and what to wear

Bring swimwear, sunscreen, a hat and a light cover-up. Towels are provided on most boats — check when booking. If you plan to jetski, bring a change of clothes. The skipper will have water and soft drinks on board, but you’re welcome to bring your own snacks if you prefer.

How to book your family boat day

For Tier A boats (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39), book directly on our site. For other boats, contact us via WhatsApp for availability and a tailored quote. We recommend booking at least 48 hours in advance, especially in summer. All prices include VAT and no hidden fees.
